about: Skill chart: for each COMD class, the job skills it builds. This is the one place to update which classes teach which skills. The Path Finder builds each job's skill list from it. 'jobs' sets each job's skills, in order and in the words students see. 'courses' lists, for each class, the skills it builds for each job. A skill can come from more than one class. Studio courses (every BFA student takes them) are shown with their skills but never change which electives are recommended.

gd.name: Graphic designer
skills: Set type, size and arrangement of layouts
Logos and brand identity systems
Base design choices on brand and marketing strategy
Product and packaging graphics
Print-ready production files (InDesign, Acrobat)
Graphics and layouts for websites (Figma)
Vector illustration (Illustrator)
Present work and act on client feedback

ad.name: Junior art director
skills: Develop concepts with a creative team
Campaigns that run across media
Present layouts to clients for approval
Run projects on budget and schedule
Direct photography and image editing (Photoshop)
Video and motion basics (After Effects)
Typography and layout

cw.name: Copywriter and content strategy
skills: Headlines, taglines and ad copy
Campaign concepts with an art director
Writing in a brand voice
Storytelling for video and social
Plan and produce content for social and digital channels
Present and defend ideas

mo.name: Motion designer
skills: 2D and 3D animation
Timing and motion principles (After Effects)
Storytelling and storyboards
Light, color, texture and realism in 3D
Plan multimedia campaigns on budget and schedule
Shoot and edit video

il.name: Illustrator
skills: Create artwork in traditional and digital media (Photoshop, Illustrator)
Use line, color and perspective to convey ideas and mood
Characters and visual development
Sequential images and storyboards
Work with art directors and editors on content
Keep a portfolio and market your work

ux.name: Visual & UX designer
skills: Design, build and maintain websites
Front-end code and scripting
Interface and user experience design (Figma)
Test, find and fix problems from user feedback
Read analytics and site traffic
Work with developers on project timelines

fe.name: Front-end developer
skills: Code websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Build and maintain sites with content tools such as WordPress
Test sites across browsers and devices
Turn user needs into technical requirements
Build from designs made in Figma
Track site performance with analytics
Work on a team with designers and developers

ve.name: Video editor
skills: Cut raw footage into a clear story
Shoot and edit video for commercials and social
Add titles, graphics and motion effects (After Effects)
Plan sequences with storyboards
Deliver video for YouTube, Instagram and TikTok
Take direction from producers and clients

cp.name: Creative producer
skills: Plan budgets, schedules and production details
Develop campaign and content ideas with a creative team
Plan shots, scenes and storyboards
Review work against the brief and quality standards
Present to clients and stakeholders
Measure results with analytics
